title.zh: 欧洲央行齐格曼：最早可能在下次会议上加息
title.en: 欧洲央行齐格曼：最早可能在下次会议上加息

current_state.zh: ECB's Zigman said the central bank could raise rates as soon as its next policy meeting, arguing gradual tightening is appropriate as the eurozone enters the ECB's adverse scenario amid a longer-than-expected energy shock.
current_state.en: ECB's Zigman said the central bank could raise rates as soon as its next policy meeting, arguing gradual tightening is appropriate as the eurozone enters the ECB's adverse scenario amid a longer-than-expected energy shock.
